title: CISCE ICSE Board Class 10th, 12th Improvement Result 2026 – Out
organization: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations
vacancyDetails: Improvement exam results for ICSE Class 10 and ISC Class 12 students who appeared for improvement papers
qualification: Students who appeared in CISCE Improvement Examination 2026
applicationFee: As paid at school for improvement exam
selectionProcess: Improvement Examination → Result on CISCE portal / DigiLocker
documentsRequired: Index Number, UID, Captcha for result login
howToApply:
1. Visit https://results.cisce.org or https://cisce.org
2. Select ICSE / ISC Improvement Result 2026
3. Enter Index Number, UID and Captcha
4. View and download result
5. Also check DigiLocker for digital documents from 24 July 2026 onwards if enabled
shortDescription: CISCE has released ICSE Class 10 and ISC Class 12 Improvement Result 2026 (around 21 July 2026). Check at results.cisce.org with Index Number and UID.
content:
The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE) has declared the Improvement Examination Results 2026 for ICSE Class 10 and related Class 12 improvement candidates.

Results can be checked on results.cisce.org and cisce.org by entering Index Number, UID and captcha. Digital copies may also be available on DigiLocker.

Students should collect updated mark sheets from their schools as per CISCE instructions.
